WITH team_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    team_id,
    AVG(CAST(w AS FLOAT)) as avg_wins,
    AVG(CASE WHEN l > 0 THEN CAST(g - l AS FLOAT) / CAST(l AS FLOAT) ELSE NULL END) as avg_ratio
  FROM manager_half
  WHERE w IS NOT NULL AND g IS NOT NULL AND l IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY team_id
),
overall_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) as mean_wins
  FROM team_stats
)
SELECT 
  team_stats.team_id,
  team_stats.avg_wins,
  team_stats.avg_ratio,
  team_stats.avg_wins - overall_mean.mean_wins as gap
FROM team_stats, overall_mean
WHERE team_stats.avg_wins > overall_mean.mean_wins
ORDER BY gap DESC,
         CASE WHEN team_stats.avg_ratio IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,
         team_stats.team_id
LIMIT 10
